title: Timer stops after about 32 seconds
serial_logs:
t=31000 blink
t=32000 blink
t=-32536 ...
(no further blinks)
user_question: LED blinks for ~32 s then stops.

reference_context.title: Arduino Language Reference (arduino.cc)
reference_context.snippet: On the Arduino Uno (ATmega-based boards) an int stores a 16-bit value, range -32,768 to 32,767. millis() returns an unsigned long; store it in an unsigned long.

expected.root_cause: millis() is stored in a 16-bit int, which overflows at 32,767 ms and goes negative, breaking the comparison.
expected.fix: Use unsigned long for now and lastBlink.
